review: We 4 came from kerala.From Egmore railway station me along with my friends went to have breakfast at this hotel which is close to station.Disappointing experience, Beware of exorbitant charges - Disappointed with the lack of transparency as they have not shared their menu card .We ordered for 2 ghee roast,2 paper roast , 4 vada 2 coffe and 1 tea .The bill amount was around 950.rs.The person who served food don't inform regarding the quantity of paper roast as one itself can be shared for 2. Won't be returning or recommending." The food is not at all extraordinary but price is extraordinary ...it s toomuch
Brilliant vegetarian lunch special, lots of items and at a reasonable price. The food was delicious, and the service from Mr Kumara vet was excellent. I will definitely visit again.

I was a regular customer of this hotel in 1980s. By chewing the memories, once again I went there to taste the same meal. But, the quality and variety of side dishes were vanished. Neatness also compromised.
Tasty food just located opp to Egmore station. Had variety of food to order round the clock. Service is quick and courteous.
Place is somewhat neat and clean. Food taste is better, not very good taste. Somewhat ok. Cost is high compared to other branch
it is located exactly opposite to egmore railway station, main place for having good south indian food at nominal money.
Vasantha Bhavan located infront of Egmore station has just one good thing it's location. The food and service is not at par as others in the same vicinity.
Good place to have South Indian food. They serve a typical chutney which is good. Price is economical Service is good. Value for money
Bang opposite to Egmore Railway station.. serves hot and fresh south indian breakfast items like idly, dosa and pongal and tea/coffee. Don't try anything adventurous. Service is quick and efficient.

On 25th August (krishna jayanti) we went on for looking veg hotel in ecr and ended up in vasantha bhavan. Lunch served in first floor. Its a day of holiday but though its not so crowded v got tables immediately nd meals served immediately. But food quality nd taste ahhh? Sambar taste like mud with pulses and rasam was heavy of garam masala. Did u notice garam masala in rasam anywhere? So we calle the floor supervisor nd asked about the chef, what she said was, they cook food in some other place nd tranaport for meals. That lady said that she vl bring feedback paper so waited for about 30 mins but she never turned back . So v left. Vasantha bhavan is a chain of restaurants in chennai with good brand name but on a holiday time hw they serve a food like this couldn't imagine. Waste of food , time, money.

I was looking for a good restaurant to have a taste of of some typical Chennai Food.  I fell for the name of 'Namma Veedu' Vasantha Bhavan which literally means 'Our Home' Vasantha Bhavan.  We have ordered for Appam with Coconut milk, Masala Dosa and Chennai Meals.  The thali to my utter surprise, did not contain the quintessential items that a South Indian thali should consist off.  There was no dhall, instead some watery sambhar.  No traditional poriyal (vegetable curry) was served.  Appalams (Papads) were served after two reminders.  Only some tasteless rasam and other namesake curries were served which looked like left over stuff at 8.30 PM!  The Appam was ok, Masala Dosa tasteless.  The waiters provided no service other than waiting at the table for their tips.
very economical, fast service but the quality of the food is not like before, would love to come again
This hotel is well located at the right place and in the middle of Marina beach, Anna salai and railway station. Easy to locate and move around if you choose this hotel. You can buy meals nearby.

Due to its location just opposite the Egmore Railway Station, this eatery is always crowded. Very reasonably priced items , snacks , lunch or dinner , with authentic South Indian taste. Service is prompt and efficient. Place needs more modernisation,  and better maintenance as far as cleanlines is considered.
A very economical & yet good hygiene & good taste for all variety of food stuff.Best part is location is ideal ,as centrally located & adjacent to Central railway station.A must visit.

This is one of the worst restaurant that I have ever visited. Recently, had been to Chennai and had to take a connecting trian to Madurai. since had some buffer time thought of relisihing the Pongal dish, that I've been recommended by some of my south indian friends. It was around 6pm, that's when I had dropped in to this restaurant. I'd ordered for a Ghee Pongal. If you look at the menu above, it is written 54/-, which was the same when I saw and subsequently ordered. But, when I went to pay the bill, the cashier, [ the worstest person I have ever seen, has a very bad attitude towards customers ], asked to me pay Rs. 65/-. I asked is it the taxes ? The reply was No. Then I told him  "in the menu it is listed as Rs. 54/-, why do I have to pay 65/- "?. The reply was in Tamil, which I could not understand. I asked him " Jab menu mein 54/- likha hai to mujhe 65/- kyun dena pad raha hai "?. The he asked a person standing next to the counter to explain me in Hindi. The explanataion was " From Morning 6am - 10am, it is 54/- but after that it is 65/-". I told him " No where in the menu it is mentioned ". The cashier denied to accept 54/-. I finally gave him, 65/- and left the place. Atleast the waiter could have made me aware of the price, but he did not. My experience after visiting this restaurant was, Absolutely NO CUSTOMER SERVICE, VERY BAD ATTITUDE SHOWN BY THE CASHIER. I have made a commitment for myself that I will not visit this Restaurant ever in my Future visits to Chennai. Even though, Ghee Pongal is my favorite dish, I would rather have it a different restaurant where the treat customer's with courtesy and dignity.

Yesterday i went with my family and had food in non ac section in 1st floor. When i suggested feedback about the food to supervisor he shouted at me saying not only me but all customers who say about food are stupid. After a long argument and when all the customers shouted at his behavior he fled the scene. Others who where there apologized on this behalf. Only if you have food inside ac you will get good service and quality otherwise this is the state of their service- i was told by other customers when coming out!
Vasntha bhawan has some branches in chennai. You can try here doasa, rice items and idli and sweets also.

This is located in T.N. Nagar opposite Hotel Residency. I wanted traditional Tamil food, but they were interested in selling me only Punjabi and Chinese dishes. I finally got only dosa. Otherwise the restaurant was clean and the dosa good. Their Coconut Puddding was excellent. Good if you want to have a quick bite.

You have just to cross the station to enter this place.Apart from the Proximity the value for your money is missing.The charges are little high .You get lots of variety food but Quality is missing.Place is untidy and service is the worst.
Its a restaurant with excellent cuisine and choice of dishes quite reasonably priced - service is also very good and the food is served without much time lag !
If you want to eat true south Indian food then visit Vasantha Bhawan, they have many branches around Chennai city.. Restaurant offers variety of cousin very much fit to the pocket
This new outlet is bright and well done. The south indian food is good. Restaurant has a good ambience and also valet parking. South Indian thali is pretty good

We are a regular visitor to this hotel as it is seen as the best hotel offering delicious food in the vicinity. We relish, among other dishes, their idiaappam with kadalai curry as we consider it as their speciality. The courteous staff, the good ambience, neatness, all go to their credit.

This is an extra ordinary place for both accommodation and also for taking meals. As this is located nearby Railway station and main road, you have easy connectivity and within a sort period of time, you can do almost all our needy works in this location.

Went there for dinner. AC restaurant is on 1st floor. ordered curry and tandoori roti, which was pretty decent. service was prompt,and  waiters were courteous Picked up a few sweets and snacks from the front counter before leaving.
Very good food as per the rates offered. Had to wait long due to rush. Service was average, dishes took long time to come
Just opposite to Egmore station. Good food and worth of money. I found chinese here very good. Have been here many times.
I had masala dosai which was no special. It was cold and the sambaar was cold too. The chutney didn't had any taste.

Went for dinner and they didn't have quiet a few items on the menu. Settled in for some onion uthappam and odi idly. Food was good, over priced though.Food was quiet late. However the waiter were courteous and friendly. Made sure they had a smile on their face and well mannered.

Hotel Vasantha Bhavan in Chennai is possibly one of the finest food joint especially for a good palatable and tasty meals during lunch or dinner. Very amicable and pleasing joint. suitable with non AC and AC dining areas. well mannered serving janitors. A must for visitors to try tamilian meals with family or friends during tours and travels.
this is really a nice to go for morning breakfast and lunch. excellent food and server hot and fresh. taste is memorable and variety of dishes on vegetarian.

Had dinner along with a friend in March during a business trip. The restaurant is located just opposite egmore station. It has a good menu of South Indian vegetarian fare which is also reasonably priced. Excellent taste and very attentive, courteous and efficient service. Highly recommended for vegetarians.

Located Exactly opposite to Egmore Station entrance. This Hotel has both AC and Non AC halls, AC is located in 1st floor and Non AC is in Ground Floor as well as 1st floor. 1) Ambiance will be really good and pleasant 2) Serving will be good 3) Waiting Time will be normal 4) Food taste will be good 5) Good Varieties of Chutneys and Podis Non AC: 1) Dining Area will be normal in First Floor and Crowded in ground floor 2) Serving Time will be quick 3) Food taste is similar to AC Hall Must Try: 1) Mushroom Dosa 2) Filter Coffee 3) Paneer Dosa Recommended for Families and Travellers
This place serves good vegetarian food at reasonable rates. If you like South Indian food, then you must visit it.

It was a surprise to see one more Vasantha Bhavan opposite to Egmore station. It's been little crowded and having some healthy food choices. The menu was quite welcoming and listed with reasonable prices.We have ordered chicpea vada(Kondakadalai vada), Kari Dosa(Soya chunks dosa), Mysore masala dosa, Idlis,Panakarkandu Paal(Crystallized Palm Sugar milk).It was so yummy and less oil used in Vada as well as in Dosa. Side dishes were quite different and tasty.My only suggestion is to maintain little hygiene while preparing the food. Quick service- 8/10 Avg ambiance- 6/10 good food -7/10

dont confuse as there are 7-8 branches of vasantabhavan in chennai..the food is tasty and delicious famous for northindian cusines and tiffins.you also can have a meals but biryani is a bad choice here.
The restaurant is very much near to the egmore railway station. just opposite to station. provides optimum range of varities and good for south-indian.

With My Family on Last September I'd visited this Hotel for Lunch.We sat in the Dining hall for about 10 minutes ,then only a waiter came ask what we want and told us that they Serve the Lunch in First floor.We go to 2nd floor for the AC option.The Restaurant is neat and Spacious. But we have to wait for almost half an hour for the Food to arrive at our Table since it was prepared outside and comes in a transport.Everything from Rice to curd will have to come from their Kitchen which was located somewhere else.For the Tiffen items only they are preparing at the same place.But the Quality of the Food is Good.Not Better,though!.And the Scenic view of the ECR from our Dining Table is good.For about 5 or 10 kilometers stretch on both sides,this the only decent veg hotel,i think!.

A great place to recharge your tamil food taste buds at this place they have got old world charm and authentic taste. Only worry for people like me is they add ghee ( clarified butter ) in their sambar which is a new taste as far my experience goes. Idlies are soft and satisfying but over all a great place to eat. And you can't go wrong in filter coffee at all.
Great place to grab a great south Indian meal, the whole dining experience over a banana leaf will leave you impressed. If not the ambience and decor will.
This hotel is one of the best vegetarian hotels near to egmore railway station.Good for service and taste

Located bang opposite the Egmore Station, and was recommended as the best around these parts. So don't read it as the best in town. We had a limited thali in the non-ac section, and were spoilt by the staff who kept bringing us reruns like extra appalaams that (we suspect) are not part of the 'limited' scheme. It's really a quick lunchtime place that does its best, and if you're looking for really nice people and atmosphere - and are okay with clean but fairly ordinary food, then go try it.

Famous Vasantha Bhavan of Chennai is located just opposite Egmore Railway station.When we come into City by train,you can just croos the road to reach here.Food available here is all south indian,north indian dishes.The south indian lu nch we had was just above average.This place should have clean toilet which is lacking,only toilet located in upstairs is untidy.

This food place is just oppiste egmore railway station, they serve indian food is cheaper than other same outlets at this area. the staff is clean & polite they top up curry without having to ask for it. & explain menu too.thank you
I like the food from this restaurant, value for money. The food is good and affordable. Preferably try south Indian food. They are much better with the south Indian choices.
...so don't expect 5 dtar hotel ambience or squeeky clealiness. But the food is very good, excellent portions and great value. If you like to tub elbows with natives... This place isa must.

The restaurant that boasts of authentic south indian is not actually authentic. you can get many better options in chennai. The only good point is its a value for money and a change from routine saravana bhavan food. The food serves is a mix of andhra and tamil style and its ok to try. There is nothing best can be boasted of but there is no major nagative point to share. They should concentrate also on cleanliness of food suppliers (to tables) and maintainance of restaurant.

The Thali meals are absolutely fantastic and without a doubt unbeatable in Chennai. the Chola Puri is fantastic too as is their Curd vada and Samba vada. Toilets and wash areas can do with some sprucing up but with the multitude of patrons eating at these hotels one cant expect top of the range facilities in every sector. I love the food there and so does my family and no trip to Chennai is complete without atleast 3 meals at one of the Vasantha Bhavans.

This is the hotel where you can get varieties of south indian food. Ofcourse north indian food are also vailable like roti, chappathi , poori etc., the food stuff is tastier and is prepared in in clean environment and with utmost care. the service s good
nice dishes but costly. Very near to station. Two seperate restaurants available here. All area veg and varieties are nice to have. Service is very prompt and unique.

Try this hotel only if you want to eat South indian food, that is their trademark, North indian food is not good. Appam and idly's are a good option to try. Avoid paneer type side dishes.Non A/C section is not well lit and doesnt look that nice. A/C section of the hotel has a good ambience.Service was ok.

i went to the vasantha bhavan restaurant opposite egmore railway station. even while entering the restaurant there was a bad odour inside the whole dining area. I ordered a rava dosa. it was cool and stale. then i reluctantly ordered for a coffee. Horrible. the milk was over boiled and so the coffee taste is very very poor. for this kind of food, the poor server expected some tips also. I had similar experience in their vadapalani branch two years back and so I avoided their restaurants for two years. unfortunately, now I went with a host and so i am NOT able to avoid. never never again to 'namma veedu vasantha bhavan' in future.
I like this place for the veg food. I had to go this place because of the other person i went with who is a veg. I liked this place and they offer quality stuff.

This review is about Vasantha Bhavan, Anna Nagar. My in-laws are non-vegetarians and they cook meat on sundays. When I was working, I used to get sundays off and could not eat at home bcos I am a pure vegetarian. It was Vasantha Bhavan, Anna nagar that I resorted to. The taste is always the same everytime. They could provide some variety in north indian items. They are not good at continental. I ordered American Chopsey and wondered if the chef even knew how it looks like. Best place if u wanna have home food away from home.
If you are looking for a fake-retro looking restaurant serving Indian "tiffen" and "fast-food" which is priced high, then this is the right place for you!

Located in Tambaram. Having good parking facility and good idly powder. Good service. But i little bothered about the credit card swipping, which is swipped in hidden place, customer cannot see where it was swipped clearly. Swipping is a financial thing, where customer may have more cautious question on their mind about their cared been misused.  Otherthan this, all the foods & varieties are very nice.
Located in Vadapalani . Best Vegetarian Food . U need to Try  Appam and Pongal
When ever i visit chennai, i usually prefer saravana bhavan. But since this place was close to hotel i stayed.. i chose to go. I had a very good break fast.

There are Vasantha Bhavans. This one is about Namma Veedu vasantha bhavan. we went to the egmore branch of this chain of restaurants. Pathetic service even in the A/C Room section!.The server takes order after 15 minutes. If some dishes are not available, they inform you after 25 minutes. One dish that we ordered did not come even after 55 minutes. The worst part is they are not apologetic at all. the waiter was very rude in answering if we ask why there is some much delay in getting a simple dish like paniyaram. The total bill for 4 people in this BUDGET restaurant came to Rs 640/- which includes just one main dish for one person.. For Veg Hakka noodles they charged a ridiculous Rs 82/- which had only 5 spoon full of noodles! For some dosas like panneer dosa or gobi dosa, they charged Rs 75 which had just a spoonful spread of the dish on an ordinary dosa!. When asked why its priced that like that, he rudely answered to go and check the menu card. My sincere advice, if you ever want to go to a fine dine restaurant nearby chennai egmore railway station, please go to nearby Buharis or even sangeethas.For a similar or lesser price, you get good service and a quantity that justifies the price.. Namma veedu vasantha bhavan is just a mere waste of your hard earned money... Happy time in Chennai -  Anand M
one of the best hotels in chennai is VASANTHA BHAVAN  it has ben very famous since many years and even we can say it is our second home it has good quyality food , and good suppliers with suplimments

The food quality is really good. I can say, it is the only plus point in this restaurant/hotel. People are not much polite, and crowd. If you feel only quality is the main thing then you can visit. This is the right place for relax
Good place for Vegetarians. Delicious Food at confordable cost. Its best place for all kind of peoples. Good Customer Service and spacious car and two wheeler parking.
